content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(ASM-002 Xpanse Active-Scan Observation Tied To Exposed Asset) AND (BIOC(ASM EAL — Inbound Vulnerability-Scan URI Fan-Out Against Perimeter Asset) OR BIOC(ASM EAL — Known Vulnerability-Scanner User-Agent On Perimeter Asset)) — raises a single exposure-management reconnaissance incident tying the discovered exposures to the live vulnerability scan probing them.
rules.name: Exposure Management — Perimeter Asset Under Active Vulnerability Scanning
